column1: # Test selectors for `chibi build test`: name, then the command, tab separated.
# the --build-host path and @root@ the checkout, all absolute; other paths are relative
# to the checkout. `group` rows list a group's selectors.
# `timeout NAME SECONDS` rows give a selector a deadline other than the runner's.
# `exclusive NAME` rows run a selector alone under --jobs: it starts its own workers or shares files.
# Generated from the retired tools/test_policy.py tables; edit it by hand now.
